meta.notes: Since torahData.js contains zero bechina-type edges for reference 1004 (LM2 Torah 4), ALL additions below represent bechina relationships present in the source text but absent from the dataset. The 'additions' array lists concepts explicitly identified by bechina language in torah_4.txt that should be entered as dataset nodes. The 'unassigned_dataset_nodes' array is empty because no bechina nodes exist in the current dataset for this Torah.

additions.reason: The ravens fed Eliyahu — explicitly called 'bechina of tzedaka' in section א. The raven's nature is cruelty (achzariut) transformed to compassion — the very definition of tzedaka.
additions.source_quote: וְאֶת הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ – זֶה בְּחִינַת צְדָקָה

additions.reason: The raven (singular) is the bechina of tzedaka — cruel by nature yet commanded to feed Eliyahu, = breaking achzariut and converting it to rachamnut. Also identified as the Poshkantza bird in the Aggadah.
additions.source_quote: כִּי הָעוֹרֵב הוּא בְּטִבְעוֹ אַכְזָרִי, וְנִתְהַפֵּךְ לְרַחֲמָנוּת לְכַלְכֵּל אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ

additions.reason: The Aramaic name for the bird in the Bava Batra aggadah that cuts off the serpent's head. Explicitly identified as 'raven = tzedaka' in section יב of the Aggadah interpretation (line 65).
additions.source_quote: אֲתָא פּוּשְׁקַנְצָא – הַיְנוּ עוֹרֵב

additions.reason: The grain offering is a bechina of tzedaka via the verse 'magishei mincha bitzedaka' (Malachi 3:3). Jacob's gift to Esau is interpreted as mincha = tzedaka.
additions.source_quote: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִנְחָתִי מִיָּדִי ... בְּחִינַת (מלאכי ג׳:ג׳): מַגִּישֵׁי מִנְחָה בִּצְדָקָה

additions.reason: The 'new mincha' from Numbers 28:26 is explicitly decoded as 'beginning of tzedaka, starting fresh to give tzedaka' in the closing exegesis (section פ).
additions.source_quote: בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַה' – הַיְנוּ הַתְחָלַת הַצְּדָקָה

additions.reason: The beginning/start of tzedaka is a bechina of 'mincha chadasha' — both are expressions of the initiating act that opens every spiritual doorway.
additions.source_quote: הַתְחָלַת הַצְּדָקָה, כְּשֶׁמַּתְחִילִין מֵחָדָשׁ לִתֵּן צְדָקָה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה

additions.reason: In the healing metaphor (section יב), tzedaka is the bechina of 'opening the wound' — the first stage of healing = opening every doorway.
additions.source_quote: צְדָקָה הִיא בְּחִינַת פְּתִיחַת פִּי הַמַּכָּה, בִּבְחִינַת: פָּתוֹחַ תִּפְתַּח

additions.reason: Cruelty (achzariut) is the raw state that tzedaka must break and transform into rachamnut. It is the starting material of the tzedaka process — belongs to the tzedaka package as the substance that tzedaka transforms.
additions.source_quote: כִּי בַּתְּחִלָּה, כְּשֶׁמַּתְחִילִין לְהִתְנַדֵּב לִצְדָקָה, אֲזַי צְרִיכִין לְשַׁבֵּר אֶת הָאַכְזָרִיּוּת שֶׁלּוֹ לְהָפְכוֹ לְרַחֲמָנוּת

additions.reason: Compassion (rachamnut) is the transformed state that results from the tzedaka process — the goal of breaking achzariut. Two poles of the same domain.
additions.source_quote: עִקָּר עֲבוֹדַת הַצְּדָקָה – לְשַׁבֵּר הָאַכְזָרִיּוּת לְהָפְכוֹ לְרַחֲמָנוּת

additions.reason: Fear of God (yirah) is the key vessel and channel (kli vetzinnor) for receiving chesed. Equated with regel as the 'end dimension' — 'sof davar hakol nishma et haElohim yera.'
additions.source_quote: רֶגֶל הוּא בְּחִינַת יִרְאָה, שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת סוֹף

additions.reason: Regel (foot/base) is bechina of yirah (section ד), bechina of causes/sibot (section ז), and in healing metaphor = washing the blood. The three Yamim Tovim are called Regalim — regel = yirah = channel.
additions.source_quote: רֶגֶל הוּא בְּחִינַת יִרְאָה, שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת סוֹף

additions.reason: The Yamim Tovim are called Regel — because through them hitgalut haRatzon is proclaimed, which creates Yirah. They are the primary mechanism of Ratzon revelation.
additions.source_quote: וְעַל כֵּן הַיָּמִים טוֹבִים נִקְרָאִים רֶגֶל, שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת יִרְאָה

additions.reason: Channel (tzinnor) — through yirah a channel is made to receive chesed: 'al yedei Yirah na'aseh chakika veTzinnor.' Always appears together with chakika as the vessel-function of yirah.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי יִרְאָה נַעֲשֶׂה חֲקִיקָה וְצִנּוֹר לְקַבֵּל עַל יָדוֹ הַחֶסֶד

additions.reason: Engraving/incision (chakika) — through yirah an engraving is made that serves as the vessel for chesed. Paired with tzinnor as the two aspects of the yirah-vessel.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי יִרְאָה נַעֲשֶׂה חֲקִיקָה וְצִנּוֹר לְקַבֵּל עַל יָדוֹ הַחֶסֶד

additions.reason: Causes/reasons (sibot) — regel = sibot per 'vaYevarekh Hashem otkha leragli = besubati' (Jacob to Laban). Regel is the bechina of causes. Yaakov attributed all causes to God; Goliath attributed them to Metzach HaNachash.
additions.source_quote: רֶגֶל הוּא בְּחִינַת סִבּוֹת

additions.reason: Washing and purifying the blood — in the healing metaphor, the Regel/Yom Tov corresponds to washing the blood so it can circulate properly. 'Ein Rogel = ein koves' per Rashi on Kings 1:9.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי רֶגֶל וְיוֹם טוֹב, שֶׁהוּא הִתְגַּלּוּת הָרָצוֹן, עַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה בְּחִינַת הֲדָחַת וְכִבּוּס הַדָּמִים

additions.reason: Shavuot is one of the three Regalim (Regel = yirah). In the closing exegesis it is specifically mentioned: 'beShavuoteikhem' = bechina of Zaken (properly aged elders who strengthen hitgalut haRatzon). It is a Regel that reveals Ratzon.
additions.source_quote: בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם – זֶה בְּחִינַת זָקֵן

additions.reason: Divine Will (Ratzon) is the central concept of this Torah — the free Will by which God created the world with no necessity (chiyuv). When revealed, Yirah is born. It is the counterforce to Metzach HaNachash (Package 5).
additions.source_quote: הוּא יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּרָא הַכֹּל בִּרְצוֹנוֹ בְּלִי שׁוּם חִיּוּב כְּלָל

additions.reason: Revelation of the Will — the Yamim Tovim proclaim that everything runs by divine Will alone, not by natural necessity. This revelation produces Yirah. The key intermediate concept linking Yamim Tovim (Package 2) and Will.
additions.source_quote: וְעִקָּר הַיִּרְאָה נַעֲשֶׂה עַל יְדֵי הִתְגַּלּוּת הָרָצוֹן

additions.reason: Forehead of the Will — the holy sage is called a bechina of Metzach HaRatzon (section ז): 'val yedei hitgalut haRatzon.' This is the good/evil mirror counterpart to Metzach HaNachash.
additions.source_quote: וְהוּא בְּחִינַת מֵצַח הָרָצוֹן, בְּחִינַת (שמות כ״ח:ל״ח): וְהָיָה עַל מִצְחוֹ לְרָצוֹן

additions.reason: Root of the Will — where Moses departed, where all individual wills must be tied. The Aggadah's 'sfinanta' (ship) is the bechina of Shoresh HaRatzon. The holy sage connects all wills to the Root.
additions.source_quote: זִמְנָא חֲדָא אָזְלֵינָא בִּסְפִינְתָּא – זֶה בְּחִינַת שֹׁרֶשׁ הָרָצוֹן

additions.reason: The great holy sage is a bechina of Metzach HaRatzon — he binds all wills to the Root of Will, where Moses departed (Zohar). He is the 'bar amorai' who descends to retrieve the precious stone.
additions.source_quote: וְהוּא בְּחִינַת מֵצַח הָרָצוֹן ... שֶׁיָּכוֹל לְקַשֵּׁר כָּל הָרְצוֹנוֹת בְּשֹׁרֶשׁ הָרָצוֹן

additions.reason: Lifting of the face (gracious acceptance) is a bechina of Ratzon — from Elisha's acceptance of Yehoshafat. The proper elder is called 'nasui panim' because he channels Ratzon.
additions.source_quote: נְשִׂיאַת פָּנִים הוּא בְּחִינַת רָצוֹן

additions.reason: The perfect stone = Ratzon (bechina). 'Even shelema reitzono' (Proverbs 11:1) — the stone David used to slay Goliath/Metzach HaNachash, and the precious stone surrounded by the serpent in the Aggadah.
additions.source_quote: הִכְנִיעוֹ עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת אֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה רְצוֹנוֹ, בְּחִינַת רָצוֹן

additions.reason: Holy convocation (mikra kodesh) — the Yom Tov calls and proclaims the Will. Explicitly equated in closing exegesis: 'kol hakriya shel Yom Tov shehu hitgalut haRatzon.'
additions.source_quote: מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם – הַיְנוּ קוֹל הַקְּרִיאָה שֶׁל יוֹם טוֹב שֶׁהוּא הִתְגַּלּוּת הָרָצוֹן

additions.reason: The proper elder ('zaken = kana chochma') is a conduit for Ratzon. His name 'nasui fanim' = Ratzon. When elders are as they should be, hitgalut haRatzon is strengthened. In closing exegesis 'beShavuoteikhem = zaken.'
additions.source_quote: זָקֵן וּנְשׂוּא פָנִים – שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זָקֵן שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה מִתְגַּבֵּר הָרָצוֹן, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְשׂוּא פָנִים

additions.reason: Chesed (loving-kindness) is the goal state — divine grace that flows when the yirah-vessel receives it. 'Olam chesed yibaneh' — the world is built by chesed when no itaruta is needed.
additions.source_quote: כֹּהַנֵי ה' דַיְקָא, בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד, בְּחִינַת: עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה

additions.reason: The priest (kohen) is bechina of chesed — in the healing metaphor, the kohen closes the wound. 'VehiSgir haKohen et hanegah' = the final stage of healing = pure chesed.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד, בְּחִינַת כֹּהֵן – עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִסְגָּר הַמַּכָּה לְגַמְרֵי

additions.reason: 'Atem kohanei Hashem tikare'u' — the state where Israel needs no labor, the world is sustained by chesed alone. This is the vision of pure chesed-state = 'olam chesed yibaneh.'
additions.source_quote: כֹּהַנֵי ה' דַיְקָא, בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד, שֶׁאֵין צְרִיכִים לַעֲשׂוֹת שׁוּם מְלָאכָה

additions.reason: Work of Creation = 'olam chesed yibaneh' (section יב). The world was created by pure chesed with no itaruta diletata at all. Also in section ג: human labor = itaruta = bechina of maase bereshit.
additions.source_quote: מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית – דְּהַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת: עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה

additions.reason: The world is built by chesed (Psalms 89) — this is the founding verse of Package 4. The Creation and the sustained state of Israel are both expressions of this principle.
additions.source_quote: הַכֹּל בְּחַסְדּוֹ בְּלִי אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא כְּלָל, בִּבְחִינַת: עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה

additions.reason: Closing the wound — in the healing metaphor, the final stage = chesed = kohen. 'VehiSgir haKohen' — through the aspect of chesed/kohen the wound is completely closed and healed.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת כֹּהֵן, חֶסֶד – עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִסְגָּר פִּי הַמַּכָּה

additions.reason: Arousal from below — needed when chesed is withheld. Human labor = itaruta diletata = bechina of maase bereshit. Belongs to Package 4 as the functional antithesis of chesed-state: when chesed flows, no itaruta is needed.
additions.source_quote: הֵם בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא, כִּי בְּעֻבְדָּא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְעַר לְעֵלָּא

additions.reason: Forehead of the serpent — the root of naturalist philosophy. The Rebbe's main evil concept in this Torah. Counterpart to Metzach HaRatzon.
additions.source_quote: בְּחִינַת מֵצַח הַנָּחָשׁ, שֶׁהוּא שֹׁרֶשׁ חָכְמַת הַטֶּבַע

additions.reason: Root of the wisdom of nature — explicitly equated with Metzach HaNachash. The philosophical root from which all naturalism grows.
additions.source_quote: שֹׁרֶשׁ חָכְמַת הַטֶּבַע הוּא בְּחִינַת מֵצַח הַנָּחָשׁ

additions.reason: Natural philosophers — those who use their 'erroneous wisdom' to show that everything runs by nature. They are called 'evil beasts that prowl and tear' (section ו).
additions.source_quote: וְהַחֲכָמִים הַלָּלוּ הֵם בְּחִינַת חַיּוֹת רָעוֹת, וְהֵם דּוֹרְסִים וְטוֹרְפִים

additions.reason: Evil beasts — the naturalist philosophers are a bechina of evil beasts. Their roaring overpowers the 'voice of the call of Yom Tov' that proclaims divine Will.
additions.source_quote: הַחֲכָמִים הַלָּלוּ הֵם בְּחִינַת חַיּוֹת רָעוֹת, וְהֵם דּוֹרְסִים וְטוֹרְפִים רַבִּים

additions.reason: The serpent in the Aggadah — identified as Metzach HaNachash. It tries to swallow the ship (= Shoresh HaRatzon). Its head is cut off by the Poshkantza/raven (tzedaka).
additions.source_quote: דְּהָדַר לֵהּ תַּנִּינָא – זֶה מֵצַח הַנָּחָשׁ

additions.reason: Goliath — sucked his power from Metzach HaNachash via 'umitzachat nechoshet al raglav.' He denied divine Will and attributed everything to natural necessity. Defeated by David (the tzaddik) via even shelema = Ratzon.
additions.source_quote: גָּלְיַת הָיָה יוֹנֵק מִמֵּצַח הַנָּחָשׁ, בִּבְחִינַת: וּמִצְחַת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל רַגְלָיו

additions.reason: The necessity of nature — the claim that everything happens by natural law alone, with no free Will. This is the conceptual content of Metzach HaNachash.
additions.source_quote: וְאֵין שׁוּם חִיּוּב הַטִּבְעִי כְּלָל

additions.reason: Denial of Will — the functional definition of what Metzach HaNachash does. Goliath denied divine Will. The naturalists deny Ratzon. This is the active force of the evil package.
additions.source_quote: כּוֹפְרִים בָּרָצוֹן

additions.reason: Wisdom (chochma) — in the healing metaphor (section יב), chochma is the bechina of the 'drawing force' (koach hamoshech) that draws out corrupted blood from inside the wound. This is a distinct bechina mentioned explicitly in the text that was not included in the initial packages. Based on context, chochma belongs with the Ratzon package — it is the deep inner wisdom that extracts from 'lifnai velifnim' (innermost places), operating at the level of Shoresh HaRatzon.
additions.source_quote: חָכְמָה הִיא בְּחִינַת כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ, בִּבְחִינַת: וּמֶשֶׁךְ חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים – מִלִּפְנַי וְלִּפְנִים

additions.reason: The drawing/extracting force — chochma is a bechina of this force that draws out the corrupted matter from deep within the wound. In the healing metaphor this is the second stage, between opening and washing. Chochma draws from the innermost depth = Shoresh HaRatzon.
additions.source_quote: חָכְמָה הִיא בְּחִינַת כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ ... שֶׁבְּחִינַת חָכְמָה מוֹשֶׁכֶת וּמוֹצִיאָה הַקִּלְקוּל מִלִּפְנַי וְלִפְנִים

analysis_notes.summary: This Torah has zero bechina edges in the dataset. All 42 nodes across 5 packages are derived from source text analysis only. The additions list above contains all 42 nodes that should be added to the dataset as bechina-connected nodes. Additionally, 2 nodes (חָכְמָה and כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ) identified from section יב of the healing metaphor are included as additions to Package 3, bringing the full additions total to 44 nodes.
